body: Fixed A01–A07: isolated Focus source failures, propagated workspace timezone to counter drafts, restored live updates after failed startup reads, enforced atomic pin admission, stabilized time-based pagination, validated browser command confirmations and removed invalid representation ETags. Corrected maintained guidance (A09). Full gate: 235 Rust, 110 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; release HTTPS/planning checks and all 18 Chromium suites pass, with final session/Focus reruns. Rebuilt and restarted the existing manual app; verified unchanged HTTPS origin/certificate, 17 resource versions, two pins and preferences. Measured optimization and the third-pass audit remain next; no acceptance or card status changed. Resume: progress/2026-09-29-three-pass-plan.md.
